info.title: Symfony2026 API Gateway
info.description: Public REST/HTTP API contract exposed through the nginx API Gateway.

get.summary: Issue CSRF token for auth endpoints
get.description: Generates a stateless CSRF token, stores its companion cookie on the API domain, and returns the token that must be sent in the configured CSRF header. Use id=api_mutation for unsafe API methods such as DELETE.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: CSRF token id. Defaults to authenticate.

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue JWT token
post.description: Authenticates a user by email, password, and Cloudflare Turnstile token, returns a JWT bearer token, and sets HttpOnly access and refresh cookies for browser clients. Call GET /api/v1/auth/csrf first and send the returned token in the CSRF header.

200.description: JWT token issued successfully. The response also sets HttpOnly cookies for access and refresh tokens when cookie support is enabled.

401.description: Invalid credentials or invalid Turnstile token.

post.description: Logs out the current user through the security firewall, clears authentication cookies, and invalidates the refresh token when it is available to the logout request. Call GET /api/v1/auth/csrf first and send the returned token in the CSRF header.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user resolved from the JWT bearer token or the AUTH_TOKEN HttpOnly cookie.

post.description: Uses the refresh token from an HttpOnly cookie or request payload and issues a new access JWT. Call GET /api/v1/auth/csrf first and send the returned token in the CSRF header.

401.description: Missing, expired, or invalid refresh token.

get.description: Returns the current user's active cart with local cart item data only.

200.description: Current cart or an empty cart representation.

400.description: X-User-Id header is missing or invalid.

delete.description: Deletes the current user's active cart and its items. The operation is idempotent.

204.description: Cart was deleted or was already absent.

400.description: X-User-Id header is missing or invalid.

post.description: Adds a product to the current user's active cart after checking resulting stock through Catalog Service.

400.description: Invalid request body or X-User-Id header.

patch.description: Updates quantity and sort for an item that belongs to the current user's active cart.

400.description: Invalid request body, unavailable quantity, or X-User-Id header.

delete.description: Deletes an item from the current user's active cart.

400.description: X-User-Id header is missing or invalid.

get.description: Returns catalog elements with full-text search and filters by direct sections, activity, prices, price types and stock availability. Legacy sectionId is combined with sectionIds using OR. Results keep the existing sort DESC, id ASC order even when query is present.

parameters.description: Legacy direct-section filter. Combined with sectionIds using OR.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Full-text search in name (boost 3) and description.

schema.description: Full-text search in name (boost 3) and description.

parameters.name: sectionIds[]
parameters.description: Direct section identifiers passed as sectionIds[]. A product may belong to any listed section (OR). Combined with legacy sectionId.

get.description: Returns complete product information with sections, prices and total stock.

Returns a flat list of active catalog sections ordered by sort descending, then ID ascending. When sections are read from Elasticsearch, only sections assigned to at least one catalog element are included.
Returns a section by ID, including inactive sections. When sections are read from Elasticsearch, a section without catalog elements is not found.

200.description: Paginated list of current user notifications.

403.description: Access denied or invalid CSRF token.

get.description: Returns the current user's orders with pagination, sorted by createdAt descending and id descending.

400.description: X-User-Id header is missing or invalid.

post.description: Creates an order from the current user's active cart, deducts stocks through Catalog Service, and stores local order item prices and product snapshot ids.

400.description: Invalid cart item, inventory request, or X-User-Id header.

404.description: Active cart or catalog product was not found.

409.description: Cart is empty, requested stock is unavailable, or price is unavailable.

502.description: Catalog Service returned an invalid response.

get.description: Returns one current-user order with items and historical product snapshot data resolved through Catalog Service.

200.description: Order with items and product snapshots.

400.description: X-User-Id header is missing or invalid.

502.description: Catalog Service returned inconsistent product snapshot data.

post.description: Cancels a current-user pending order and publishes an OrderCanceledMessage after the status is saved.

400.description: X-User-Id header is missing or invalid.

409.description: Order is already canceled or cannot be canceled from the current status.
